verdict.recommendedAction: Check the AWS Health Dashboard for S3 in us-east-1. Make the S3 artifact write in payment-svc asynchronous or best-effort (queue it and retry later), so a storage outage doesn't fail the charge. Cap SDK retries so requests fail fast. If possible, fail over to a bucket replica in another region.
